pattern.description: The chat transcript scrolls up inside the fixed Cirrus Virtual Agent panel, pushing the agent's order-status reply up and bringing the user's scheduling message into view.
pattern.why_premium: Real product chat is shown with a smooth, eased auto-scroll clipped by the panel mask, so the conversation reads as live without cuts while the page around it stays still.

build_hint.gsap: Clip the transcript in the panel (overflow hidden); gsap.to('.transcript', {y: '-=~190px', duration: 0.35, ease: 'power2.out'}) moving bubbles, avatar and timestamp as one group; the new user bubble is already in the stack below the fold and arrives with the scroll.
build_hint.remotion: Wrap the message stack in an overflow-hidden container; translateY = interpolate(spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 170}}), [0, 1], [0, -190]) applied to the whole stack, no overshoot.

notes: b01 is the diff box covering the scrolling transcript; per-line OCR boxes (b05-b15, b17-b19) are parts of the same moving block and are not listed separately. User bubble lines b02/b04 belong to b03's bubble.
